summary: H.R. 7212, titled the Hemp Enforcement, Modernization, and Protection Act, amends the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act to establish a comprehensive federal regulatory framework for cannabinoid hemp products through the Food and Drug Administration (FDA). The bill sets definitions, manufacturing standards, facility registration requirements, labeling mandates, age limits, and enforcement mechanisms for oral, inhalable, and topical cannabinoid hemp products.

affected_groups.effect: Must register facilities, submit product listings, comply with strict manufacturing, testing, and labeling standards, and adhere to mandatory recall and inspection authorities.
affected_groups.group: Manufacturers, packers, and distributors of cannabinoid hemp products

affected_groups.effect: Forbidden from selling cannabinoid hemp products to individuals under 21 years of age.
Subject to minimum age sales limits and provided with enhanced product labeling, QR code testing access, and child-safety packaging.

key_provisions: Defines cannabinoids and cannabinoid hemp products, distinguishing between oral, inhalable, and topical products, and sets rules for prohibited cannabinoid products.

Establishes labeling standards requiring clear disclosures of contents, serving sizes, major allergens, risk disclaimers, QR codes linked to certificates of analysis, and bans child-appealing packaging features.
Sets standards for inhalable and oral cannabinoid products, including ingredient restrictions, sourcing requirements, and pre-market notifications.
Prohibits retailers from selling cannabinoid hemp products to anyone under 21 years of age.
Requires domestic and foreign facilities that manufacture, process, pack, hold, or import cannabinoid hemp products to register with the Secretary and submit product listings.
Grants the FDA mandatory recall authority and the power to suspend facility registrations if products have a reasonable probability of causing serious adverse health consequences or death.
Establishes a Cannabinoid Hemp Products Advisory Committee to provide advice and recommendations to the Secretary on cannabinoid content limits.
missing_information: The exact numerical thresholds for total cannabinoid and intoxicating cannabinoid content, which are delegated to future rulemaking by the Secretary.
Specific details regarding penalties outside of enhanced criminal penalties for knowing violations of section 301(jjj).
